name: @hydra/dsh-fleet-teams-ui
description: Prototype: the V3 teams chat UI — a fleet-hosted rooms page (board-server pattern) that renders each room's chat thread (fleet/team-post events + the shared-room memory briefing) with sender name/avatar/role badges resolved from the fleet-agent profile registry, a grant-checked composer, and a team menu opening a team/room settings dialog (room name, members + grants read/post/join, memory file, scope, linked tasks, archive). Consumes ctx.fleetTeams / ctx.fleetAgent / the fleet-bus store; the dsh web app is never touched. Issue #26.
